column1: # BPMN 2.0 and DMN counters (.bpmn, .bpmn20.xml, .dmn of Camunda 7 and 8, Flowable, Activiti, jBPM):
# the counters of xml-facts, its [ignore] line included, then a second [ignore] line that blanks the
# diagram interchange (BPMNDiagram, DMNDI: shapes, edges, waypoints), which is layout, not logic, and
# one counter per process element, with or without a namespace prefix. "tasks" counts every task type;
# "Java delegate bindings" a class, delegateExpression or expression attribute of Camunda, Flowable or
# Activiti; "decision rules" the <rule> of a DMN decision table. A diagram section that is never
# closed runs to the end of the file. EnterpriseXmlFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
external task topics, job types and work items
